def getExtensionList(self,extensions):
        """
        This is an internal method that transforms the comma-separated extensions string
        into a list of extensions, e.g., "ext1,ext2,ext3" gets turned into ['.ext1','.ext2','.ext3'].
        If MapConstants.placeholderNoExtensionFilter is part of the string, the resulting list
        will also contain '', i.e., files without extensions are permitted.
        """
        # remove any spaces
        extensions = extensions.replace(' ','')
        # create a list of extensions
        extensionList = []
        # if the string contains MapConstants.placeholderNoExtensionFilter, add an empty string
        # to the list
        if MapConstants.placeholderNoExtensionFilter in extensions:
            extensionList.append('')
        # otherwise, split the string by commas and add each part to the list
        else:
            extensionList += extensions.split(',')
        # make sure each entry ends with a dot
        for index in range(len(extensionList)):
            if not extensionList[index].startswith('.'):
                extensionList[index] = '.' + extensionList[index]
        # return the list
        return extensionList
